newsitem.title: UK: N.Irish police fire shots at stolen car.
newsitem.headline: N.Irish police fire shots at stolen car.

text.p: Police in Northern Ireland opened fire at a stolen car on Monday evening as it drove at high speed through a security checkpoint in Londonderry.
Police said there were no reports of injuries and the car and its occupants were still at large.
"Police fired a number of shots at the vehicle," a spokesman for Northern Ireland's Royal Ulster Constabulary said.
The car had been stopped at another nearby checkpoint 30 minutes earlier, but as police approached it drove off, narrowly missing an officer.
